references.text: Like Isaiah 53:10-12, Matthew 20:28 points to a service and sacrifice—that Christ would give his life as a ransom for many.
Psalm 49:15 speaks of God's power to redeem from death, pointing forward to Jesus' sacrifice.
Luke 22:27 also highlights Jesus' role as a servant, in line with what is described in Matthew 20:28.
Mark 10:45 parallels Matthew 20:28 by stating that Jesus came to serve and give his life as a ransom for many.
1 Peter 1:18-19 speaks of being redeemed by Christ's precious blood, reflecting the idea of a ransom in Matthew 20:28.
